  • Eufaula↗Historical Muscogee town connection
    Connection & source
    Historical Muscogee town connection

    Actual OHS article says Oklahoma civic town was named after a Muscogee tribal town in Alabama. This indexes that historical Alabama town, not the modern municipality as a people.

  • Mobile↗Historical people and village geography in specialist scholarship
    Connection & source
    Historical people and village geography in specialist scholarship

    The account identifies Mobile among Indigenous peoples of the Mobile Bay area in 1702 and separately describes the French settlement near a Mobilian village. This supplies an Alabama historical connection through explicit people/village evidence, rather than through the later city name alone. Inspection: Actual geography/context and settlement paragraphs, HTML lines 70–88, plus named Mobile people passage at line 95 and author/date credit at 151–161 inspected. Limits: Mobile people, the colonial town and the modern city are distinct referents. This does not establish present government continuity, a census or equivalence with all speakers of Mobilian trade language.

    Mobile Bay communities around French settlement in 1702. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
